title: Sunlit Rooftop Views
description: Soaking in the warm terracotta rooftops and intricate stonework under a bright blue Lisbon sky.
altText: Intricate stone building facade in Lisbon with red-tiled rooftops and pastel-coloured houses rolling into the background.

title: Lisbon's Wavy Rhythm
description: Chilling by the grand fountain where classic cobbled waves lead straight into the city's lively heart.
altText: Broad city square in Lisbon featuring a dark bronze fountain, tall monument column, and distinctive black-and-white wave-patterned cobblestone pavement.

title: Riding the Rails
description: Catching a cosy front-row seat on Lisbon's iconic tram as it slowly winds through narrow sunny streets.
altText: View from inside a historic Lisbon tram showing the driver's perspective heading down a narrow cobblestone street lined with buildings.

title: Vintage Tram Vibes
description: Classic yellow trams rolling past vibrant red buildings, adding that unmistakable retro charm to the city.
altText: Vintage yellow and white street tram stopped at a glass shelter in front of a bold red European-style building.

title: Alfama Horizon Dreams
description: Sweeping views over coastal rooftops and white church spires where the city meets the calm blue waters.
altText: High-angle panoramic view of Lisbon's Alfama district featuring white buildings with red-tiled roofs leading towards the river bank.

title: Rustic Doorway Love
description: Lush potted greenery and sweet street art creating the ultimate bohemian welcome in Lisbon.
altText: Dark green wooden door surrounded by potted ferns, climbing vines, and a spray-painted heart on a sun-dappled white wall.

title: Cobbled Backstreet Wanders
description: Getting blissfully lost along quiet, historic alleyways steeped in old-world Portuguese charm.
altText: Narrow, uphill cobblestone street lined with weathered, rustic buildings leading toward an ancient stone archway under a blue sky.

title: Local Art Haven
description: Uncovering hidden creative gems behind vibrant turquoise doors nestled in the city's rustic corners.
altText: Bright turquoise wooden door of a studio gallery set in a rustic brick and plaster wall, accompanied by a chalkboard sign saying Support Local Art.

title: Framed City Vistas
description: Peer through ancient stone arches for a breathtaking look over Lisbon's endless sea of terracotta roofs.
altText: View through a pointed stone window frame looking out over colourful cityscape buildings and red roofs under a blue sky.

title: Feathered Local Royalty
description: Stumbling upon majestic peacocks showing off their vibrant plumage near historic stone courtyards.
altText: Two peacocks displaying their full, colorful tail feathers on a stone patio alongside a rustic stone wall.

title: Rooftop Feathers & Sunshine
description: Local peacocks perching high above the streets, effortlessly soaking up the sunny Lisbon vibes.
altText: Three peacocks perched atop a high metal fence in front of a yellow and white Portuguese building under a clear blue sky.

title: Eclectic Street Character
description: Quirky alleyway details packed with colourful stickers, rustic textures, and creative local spirit.
altText: A white door and stone wall adorned with a sticker-covered street sign reading Rua do Espírito Santo and colourful wooden accents.

title: Alfresco Sundowner Sipping
description: Unwinding at a cosy pavement café with cold beers and warm afternoon sunshine.
altText: Two glasses of beer on a chequered tablecloth at an outdoor café table, with a potted green plant and patio dining in the background.

title: Golden Hour Glow
description: Catching magic over the river as the setting sun paints the skyline in dazzling gold.
altText: Bright golden sunset over a wide river, casting brilliant light across the water towards a distant suspension bridge and monument silhouette.

title: Golden Plaza Dusk
description: Soaking in the warm twilight skies and grand historic silhouettes across Lisbon's open square.
altText: Grand square in Lisbon at sunset with a bronze equestrian statue on a high pedestal set against a fiery yellow sky.

title: Fresh Local Feast
description: Indulging in simple, delicious grilled sardines and boiled potatoes for an authentic taste of Portugal.
altText: Plate of grilled sardines served with boiled potatoes and a side salad on a restaurant table.

title: Nighttime Funicular Magic
description: Watching glowing yellow funiculars climb cobbled hills as streetlamps light up the night.
altText: Illuminated yellow funicular tram stopped on a steep cobbled hill at night next to a glowing streetlamp.

title: Intricate Brass Knocker Details
description: Spotting charming antique details hidden away on old wooden doors throughout the city.
altText: Pair of ornate hand-shaped brass door knockers attached to a dark green painted wooden door.
